authority: XPath 3.1 F&O 4.7.5: "If the sub-picture contains a per-mille character, the adjusted number is the input number multiplied by 1000", giving 1234567.8, which rounds to 1234568 at maximum-fractional-part-size 0. The per-mille sign is passive and stands left of the leftmost active character, so 4.7.4 makes it the prefix.
